diagnosis: High-grade serous carcinoma of the fallopian tube
legend: The gross appearance of the carcinoma, which forms a sausage-like tubal enlargement.

diagnosis: High-grade serous carcinoma of the fallopian tube
legend: These images reveal the histology of the carcinoma at various magnifications. The tumour shows slit-like spaces and papillary formations in the fallopian tube. The tumour cells have markedly atypical nuclei with brisk mitotic activity.
